title: From Darkness to Detail: Frequency-Aware SSMs for Low-Light Vision
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of 'ExpoMamba', a model for low-light image enhancement. It evaluates the model's performance on visual quality metrics like PSNR and SSIM and human perceptual rankings based on image attributes such as brightness and noise. There is no discussion or evaluation concerning religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
